report.success_criterion: On the buggy revision (commit d93d0ab799dd), the targeted test fails (exception raised/incorrect handling) when it includes `np.datetime64('NaT', 'ns')` inputs (as per the provided diff). On the fixed revision (PR #11340 applied/merged), the same test passes because xarray’s CF time decoding/special-value handling detects NaT before hitting the NumPy >=2.5 overflow-prone multiplication path.

examples.input: xarray decode/coding path receives integer-encoded CF time values where the NaT sentinel is `np.iinfo('int64').min`, under NumPy >= 2.5.
examples.expected_output: NaT sentinel is detected up front so the multiplication path is not taken; decoding yields `pd.Timestamp('NaT')` (or equivalent NaT result), and no exception is raised.
examples.buggy_output_reported: Raises `OverflowError` during `int64.min * np.timedelta64(1, unit)` which surfaces as `ValueError: unable to decode time units '...'` from `decode_cf`.
